### The Mysteries of God
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-28-2026.html
Passage: Romans 11:33
Points:
- Reading the entire Bible will never fully remove every mystery regarding God.
- Believers must accept that God's ways and judgments are unsearchable and unfathomable by design.
- Profound doctrines such as the Trinity, God's glory, sovereignty, and majesty exceed human understanding.
- Instead of exhausting ourselves trying to figure out the inexplicable, we should trust God in faith and revere Him.

### How Do You Pray to God?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-march-12-2023.html
Passage: Romans 11:36
Points:
- All things exist from, through, and to God, making His own glory His primary purpose.
- Unanswered prayers often stem from seeking personal gain rather than honoring God.
- Praying in Jesus' name fundamentally means desiring that the Father be glorified in the Son.
- Believers should realign their prayer life around praise and thanksgiving for God's glory.
